alias: Purifier — run after the cat toilet
description: v6. Runs the corridor purifier after a cat visit for up to ~28 minutes, ending early only if the trusted PM2.5 reading rose and came back down. Ownership is claimed BEFORE the fan is commanded, a new run first cancels any stop still in flight from the run it restarted, the start is retried until the fan has held 'on' for 15 s, and every stop goes through script.purifier_stop_reliably, which waits out the miio link's frequent 'unavailable' dropouts and retries until the fan reports off. 'Unreachable' is never read as 'off'.
